title: nf-core/integrationsiteanalysis pipeline parameters
description: Genomic integration-site analysis from long reads.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a YAML samplesheet describing the samples to analyse.
input.help_text: The YAML samplesheet is a list of entries, each with a sample `id` and `reads` (long-read FASTQ). Optional per-sample keys (`reference`, `blast_queries`, `plasmid`, `purge`, `target_coverage`, `busco_lineage`) override the corresponding global parameters. Optional `primary` and `alternate` FASTA paths (`.fa`/`.fasta`/`.fna`, optionally gzipped) skip hifiasm for that sample; both must be set, or neither. See `assets/schema_input.json` for the full contract.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Options controlling downsampling, assembly, purging, BLAST and read mapping.

reference.description: Reference genome FASTA used to size the downsampling target. Can be overridden per-sample.

annotation.description: Reference genome annotation in GFF3 or GTF, optionally gzipped. Genes overlapping each hit are lifted onto that hit and shown in the IGV report. Can be overridden per-sample. Omit to skip lifting.

blast_queries.description: Directory or file glob of construct query FASTAs to BLAST against the assemblies. Can be overridden per-sample.

plasmid.description: Plasmid annotation file in GenBank (.gb/.gbk) or SnapGene (.dna) format. Features are extracted and BLAST-transferred onto hit windows. Can be overridden per-sample.

plasmid_min_identity.description: Minimum percent identity required to transfer a plasmid feature onto an extracted hit window.

plasmid_min_feature_length.description: Minimum feature length (bp) to include when extracting plasmid features for BLAST annotation.

plasmid_blast_evalue.description: E-value threshold for BLAST of plasmid features against an integration-site window. Looser than blast_evalue so short cassette parts are retained. Transfer still requires plasmid_min_identity.

target_coverage.description: Target read coverage for downsampling (relative to the reference genome size). Can be overridden per-sample.

seqkit_seed.description: Random seed used by seqkit when subsampling reads (for reproducibility).

run_purging.description: Run purge_dups on the primary assembly. Can be overridden per-sample with the `purge` samplesheet key.

busco_lineage.description: BUSCO lineage dataset (e.g. `eukaryota_odb10`) or an `auto`/`auto_euk`/`auto_prok` mode. Can be overridden per-sample.

blast_evalue.description: E-value threshold for blastn searches of assemblies. Plasmid feature transfer uses plasmid_blast_evalue instead.

flank_size.description: Number of flanking base pairs to include on each side of a BLAST hit when extracting integration-site sequences.

igv_locus_pad.description: Base pairs added on each side of the integration alignment. IGV reports keep reads that overlap this padded locus.

igv_view_bp.description: Minimum initial IGV report view in base pairs. Larger insertions use the alignment plus igv_locus_pad on each side.
igv_view_bp.help_text: The HTML report and MultiQC snapshot open on this window, centered on the insertion. It is independent of which reads are kept (igv_locus_pad). A shorter extract is shown in full.

junction_anchor_bp.description: Aligned bases required on each side of a junction before a read counts as flank-spanning.

junction_window_bp.description: A clip or split counts at a junction when its breakpoint is within this many bases of the junction.

junction_depth_pad.description: Bases on each side of a junction included in the junction-local mean depth.

locus_merge_distance.description: Maximum gap in base pairs between BLAST hits on the same contig that are still called one integration locus.
locus_merge_distance.help_text: Set this to about the length of the inserted construct. Feature hits from a single insert sit closer together than the insert itself, so they collapse to one locus. A second insert farther away than this distance stays its own locus.

downstream_hits.description: Which extracted sequences are used for read mapping and plasmid annotation.
downstream_hits.help_text: `auto_loci` runs downstream analysis on one window per predicted integration locus. `all_hits` keeps every BLAST hit, including separate query features from the same locus. Both sets are always written under `extracted_hits/`.

integration_dbs.description: Which assembly FASTAs are searched and published under integration-results/.
integration_dbs.help_text: `all` builds primary, alternate, and combined BLAST databases. `combined` searches only the concatenated assembly. `prim_and_alt` searches the two haplotypes and does not build the combined database. Mapping, IGV, and dotplots follow the same set.

variants.description: Include Medaka VCF variants as a track in per-hit IGV HTML reports.

call_small_variants.description: Call SNVs and small indels with DeepVariant's PacBio model on each extracted hit.
call_small_variants.help_text: Uses the existing per-hit BAM and the extracted FASTA. Coordinates are the hit window, including flanks, not host chromosome coordinates. The VCF is added to that hit's IGV report. Pass false to skip calling and leave the report unchanged.

call_structural_variants.description: Call structural variants with Sniffles2 on a host-plus-plasmid alignment.
call_structural_variants.help_text: One alignment per sample against the host reference with plasmid contigs prefixed plasmid_. These calls are not evidence that a rearrangement is a plasmid integration. The VCF is shown in a separate per-sample IGV report, not on the per-hit report. Pass false to skip calling.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
